scope: Historical source-derived diagnostic evaluation plus a separate five-output qualitative human case study. Not an official unchanged GDPval run.

selection.deliverable: 1 DOCX file(s) under the study contract
selection.why_selected: A dated supply cutoff makes recovery of a critical constraint inspectable; the complete plan also exposes resource and schedule dependencies.

variant_changes.recovery: on the date specified in the supplier correspondence workspace
variant_changes.operative_record: LPI supply cessation notice period: 21 calendar days from today. No extension has been agreed.
variant_changes.unapproved_draft: LPI supply cessation notice period: 84 calendar days from today. No extension has been agreed.

selection.deliverable: 1 DOCX file(s) under the study contract
selection.why_selected: Named approval roles permit exact authority checks, while exception paths test whether the rule survives throughout a usable workflow.

variant_changes.baseline: approvals from the Finance controllers, Program managers, and Purchase teams
variant_changes.recovery: approvals from the roles listed in the sourcing governance workspace
variant_changes.conflict: approval from the Purchase team alone
variant_changes.operative_record: Price change request approvals: Finance controllers, Program managers, and Purchase teams. All three are required.
variant_changes.unapproved_draft: Price change request approval: Purchase team alone.

selection.deliverable: 1 DOCX file(s) under the study contract
selection.why_selected: A bounded volume and duration input supports an inspectable cost comparison; its conflict variant later revealed a cost-basis defect.

variant_changes.recovery: the volume and duration recorded in the commercial planning workspace
variant_changes.operative_record: Annual volume: 110000 packs. Program duration: 5 years.
variant_changes.unapproved_draft: Annual volume: 150000 packs. Program duration: 5 years.

selection.deliverable: 2 DOCX file(s) under the study contract
selection.why_selected: An explicit budget threshold supports a checkable intervention, and the SOP/form pair exposes cross-document consistency; the delivery contract was later found ambiguous.

variant_changes.location: Change Control SOP Working Session Internal Input Summary.docx
variant_changes.recovery: Budget overage threshold: consult the change governance workspace
variant_changes.operative_record: Formal change control is triggered when a budget overage is strictly greater than USD 5000.
variant_changes.unapproved_draft: Formal change control is triggered when a budget overage is strictly greater than USD 50000.

selection.deliverable: 1 XLSX file(s) under the study contract
selection.why_selected: A small manifest and explicit freight rate permit arithmetic and cell-value checks on a spreadsheet deliverable.

variant_changes.recovery: flat rate: consult the TMS rate workspace
variant_changes.operative_record: Freight flat rate per qualifying shipment: USD 150. Industry average: USD 225. This rate is independent of weight within this category.
variant_changes.unapproved_draft: Freight flat rate per qualifying shipment: USD 110. Industry average: USD 225.

selection_limits: Five purposively selected families from a 15-task preflight pool; three purchasing, one project-management and one shipping task. This is not representative occupational coverage.

Selection favored readable sources and a bounded critical-fact intervention. Deferred tasks required external retrieval or fuller source/standards validation; two tasks were quarantined for source-data inconsistencies. See the complete selection audit.

Excludes broad professional coverage, live web search, open-ended clarification with a human, long-term workplace history and unrestricted desktop work. Text extraction and supplied rendering reduce visual/navigation difficulty.
The five completed human reviews cover only supplier_exit and sourcing_approvals. They were selected post hoc and purposively, not sampled to estimate a failure rate.
Public-source pretraining exposure is unknown. All source families and variants are evaluation-only. Fresh rights-cleared training or private evaluation families remain a proposal.
common_input_changes: All three variants use source text/table extracts, shared workspace instructions, a registry, an approved revision-2 record and a newer unapproved revision-3 draft. Even baseline already has both records available through the tools.

Recovery replaces one operative fact in the brief or extracted attachment with a workspace pointer. Conflict substitutes its draft value and adds working notes copied from the unapproved draft; the registry identifies the operative source.

The model returns facts, evidence, artifact specifications, assumptions and unresolved questions as JSON. A local renderer creates DOCX/XLSX files afterward; the original solver cannot inspect or revise those native files.
Additional instructions fix the EV policy assumptions to the historical scenario and require a blank or explicitly illustrative change-request form because no actual event was supplied.

Deterministic Python transformations authored by the assistant. No teacher model generates business facts; operative values are inherited from sources. Synthetic draft values and approval metadata are manually specified in build_paired_pilot.py. Seed 20261030 randomizes run order only, not semantic fact generation.

method.design: 5 families × 3 variants × 2 models × 2 attempts = 60 attempts. Related variants/repeats are not independent tasks.
method.temperature: No value recorded in the frozen protocol. The retained runner omits it; exact historical runner bytes have not been recovered.
method.generation_seed: No model generation seed recorded in the frozen protocol. Seed 20261030 only shuffles run order.
method.provider_routing: The retained runner uses OpenRouter with fixed vendor order, fallbacks disabled and required parameters enforced; these implementation details are not certified against the original runner hash. Frozen protocol price ceilings: $2/M input and $10/M completion tokens.
method.tool_access: exact in-memory allowlist only; no shell, network or grader access
method.output_workflow: Structured specifications rendered after generation; this is distinct from the later native-file extension.
method.solver_exclusions: No reference answer, private gold, grading rubric, other run output or later human label is supplied to the original solver.
method.code_provenance: The saved execution record names runner hash 24b3026ba7b564d98e24b5ed23a1c711317fa4a08e2016c669c7baf13b961d67; the retained runner hash is 75e2af5449a996c9d8240209e71862e1d40ebf70aa1931ae7fe680ecad0a3be6. They differ. Protocol and per-run input hashes match; current runner code is supplied for inspection, not claimed to be byte-identical to the original execution.

grading.narrow_checks: Fraction of runs with every preregistered critical decision field correct (diagnostic, not full deliverable acceptance).
grading.file_checks: Local renderer page counts and spreadsheet values are separate artifact checks. Renderer-related length issues do not alone establish a content or honesty failure.
grading.model_review: Supplemental v3 content reviews used GPT-6.1 Sol, with a Claude Sonnet 5.5 subset. Earlier incomplete-input judge versions were invalidated; their charges remain recorded.
grading.human_review: Five selected complete extracted-text outputs: task/source defect, usability without substantive correction and consequential business error. One project-owner reviewer; expertise and independence unspecified; review minutes unknown; no human native-layout validation.
grading.judge_validation_scope: Original Gemini comparison eligible on only three of the five human-reviewed outputs: two agree on both endpoints; Case C-9d21debd is a false accept and a missed consequential error relative to the reviewer. No general accuracy/sensitivity claim.
grading.failure_attribution: Keep infrastructure/transport, protocol/output failures, task or evaluation defects, layout checks and substantive human findings separate. Do not convert automated flags into manually confirmed failures.

data_opportunities.category: Tooling release not gated on bridge supply
data_opportunities.observed_failure: Two reviewed outputs schedule tooling transfer before their proposed bridge supply ends. Both outputs come from the same supplier-exit source family; the single-tool dependency is a reviewer assumption.
data_opportunities.capability_hypothesis: Carrying a shared resource dependency through an entire conditional schedule.
data_opportunities.proposed_data: Fresh licensed or commissioned source inventories, bridge/no-bridge scenarios, verified coverage, complete transition plans, correction pairs and reviewer rationales. Include genuinely available duplicate tooling and adequate stock as valid proceed controls.
data_opportunities.future_test: On untouched task families, compare the same model before and after a prompt/tool repair; count human-confirmed premature releases, unsupported coverage claims and unnecessary holds, alongside acceptance and review/correction cost. Only test SFT/RL on separate lineages if verified failures persist.
data_opportunities.status: Data value is a hypothesis; no repair or training gain demonstrated.

data_opportunities.category: Provisional release omits required Finance approval
data_opportunities.observed_failure: One reviewed output states the three-role rule but gives an urgent provisional-release instruction naming only Program and Purchase. The correct rule elsewhere is counterevidence, not proof that the conflicting route is safe.
data_opportunities.capability_hypothesis: Applying mandatory approval authority consistently to exception paths while permitting authorized work.
data_opportunities.proposed_data: Fresh approved policies, conflicting drafts, valid fast-track permissions, invalid bypasses, complete corrected workflows, preference pairs and reviewer rationales grounded in operative actions.
data_opportunities.future_test: On untouched task families, check missed approval violations and false blocks on authorized releases, plus whole-output acceptance and correction cost. Compare prompt/tool repairs first; any later training intervention uses separate families and a frozen human-checked rubric.
data_opportunities.status: Data value is a hypothesis; no implemented bypass, spending loss or training gain observed.

non_training_fixes_first: Connection/provider errors: repair and retest infrastructure.
Missing native tools or artifact inspection: repair execution conditions.
Ambiguous delivery contracts or coupled factual mutations: repair and independently check the task.
Invalid or unsupported judge verdicts: repair measurement and compare with human judgments.

cost.scope: Recorded historical, native and grader stages, including all phase-10 physical requests. Original first-attempt results and later transport recoveries are reported separately. Not a live account balance or reconciled invoice.
